title: Security surface self-service branch renders when credentialSelfService applied
asA: authenticated principal managing my credentials in-place
iWant: a security surface rendering a self-service password-change and MFA-management branch when the applied auth blueprint declares credentialSelfService
soThat: I can change my password and manage second factors without leaving the product

acceptanceCriteria.description: When credentialSelfService is in the applied capability set, GET /account/security renders <div data-surface="security" data-branch="self-service"> containing a [data-role="change-password"] form and a [data-role="mfa-management"] region. Absent from render when credentialSelfService is not applied. Probed by pack check AC-25105-1 (unified security check).

The self-service credential-change surface never accepts a new password without a fresh reauthentication when the elicited reauth-window says so (REQ-007); a submit without a passing reauth refuses with REAUTH_REQUIRED.
acceptanceCriteria.given: credentialSelfService applied with reauth-window > 0 and the current session past the elapsed threshold
acceptanceCriteria.when: the principal submits a new password
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submit refuses with REAUTH_REQUIRED and no credential change occurs
